# Extractor fixtures

The `*.md` files are goldens: what an extractor writes for the fixture of the
same name. Regenerate them with `go test ./internal/files/extract -update`.
The DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and HTML fixtures, and most PDFs, are built in the tests
(`fixtures_test.go`, `pdf_test.go` and the `pdftest` package), so they are
reproducible from source.

## chrome-board.pdf

The one PDF from a real producer: Chrome's print-to-PDF (Skia/PDF m156), which
embeds Cyrillic as Type0 fonts with the Identity-H encoding and a ToUnicode
CMap, positions each glyph separately, and draws under a flipped coordinate
system. It was made on macOS (2026-10-23) from `chrome-board.html` below:

    "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless=new \
      --disable-gpu --no-pdf-header-footer \
      --print-to-pdf=chrome-board.pdf file://$PWD/chrome-board.html

```html
<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14pt} .p{page-break-after:always}</style></head><body>
<div class="p"><h1>Протокол засідання правління</h1><p>Рішення: затвердити бюджет на 2027 рік.</p><p>Голова правління: Іван Петренко. Ґанок, їжак, є.</p></div>
<div><h2>Додаток</h2><p>Друга сторінка з текстом.</p></div>
</body></html>
```

The bytes differ per run (the creation date and font subset tags), so the file
is committed rather than regenerated by the tests.
